content.heading: Imports and ideasets
content.body: One file is a start. Real graphs span files — imports keep links honest.

slides.notes: One file is a great start. Real projects become a web of files.

content.heading: From-import one idea
content.body: Pull a single neighbour when that is all the call site needs.

content.heading: Namespace the file
content.body: Alias the whole module when several ideas travel together.

slides.notes: Namespace import gives you a prefix for the whole file.

content.heading: Ideasets as namespaces
content.body: Group related ideas without a heavier module system.

content.heading: Try this
content.body: Move password_rules into auth.rq. Fix product.rq with the smallest import that works.

slides.notes: Pick the import shape that keeps call sites readable.
